D"],"accepted":{"date-parts":[[2026,4,29]]},"abstract":"<jats:p>We derive static spherically symmetric regular black holes as vacuum solutions to purely gravitational theories in four dimensions. To that end, we construct four-dimensional nonpolynomial gravities starting from subclasses of two-dimensional Horndeski actions. By construction, these theories possess second-order equations of motion on spherically symmetric backgrounds. We show that a subset of these nonpolynomial gravities, referred to as nonpolynomial quasitopological gravities, admit single-function static spherically symmetric solutions whereby the metric function is determined by an algebraic equation. Solutions to these theories include the Hayward regular black-hole spacetime, for which a corresponding gravitational action is stated explicitly.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1103\/6x2z-qbkh","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2026,4,29]],"date-time":"2026-04-29T19:20:26Z","timestamp":1777490426000},"update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1103\/crossmark-policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":11,"title":["Regular black holes from pure gravity in four dimensions"],"prefix":"10.1103","volume":"113","author":[{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0001-7125-4372","authenticated-orcid":true,"given":"Johanna","family":"Borissova","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"id":[{"id":"https:\/\/ror.org\/041kmwe10","id-type":"ROR","asserted-by":"publisher"}],"name":"Imperial College London"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0001-6389-6105","authenticated-orcid":true,"given":"Ra\u00fal","family":"Carballo-Rubio","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"id":[{"id":"https:\/\/ror.org\/04ka0vh05","id-type":"ROR","asserted-by":"publisher"}],"name":"Instituto de Astrof\u00edsica de Andaluc\u00eda (IAA-CSIC)"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"16","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2026,6,2]]},"reference":[{"key":"6x2z-qbkhCc1R1","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","DOI":"10.1103\/PhysRevLett.14.57","type":"journal-article"},{"key":"6x2z-qbkhCc2R1","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","DOI":"10.1098\/rspa.1970.0021","type":"journal-article"},{"key":"6x2z-qbkhCc3R1","doi-asserted-by":"crossref","DOI":"10.1017\/9781009253161","type":"book","volume-title":"The Large Scale Structure of Space-Time","author":"S.\u2009W.
